<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Internship" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/internship">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_InternshipOffer" name="Internship offer"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Internship">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" name="Internship offer" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" messageRef="Message_InternshipOffer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Internship" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Applicant" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney" name="Enter topic of interest and desired amount of money"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies" name="Enter experience and hobbies"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer" name="Receive an internship offer" messageRef="Message_InternshipOffer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferDecision" name="Accept or deny offer" default="Flow_DenyOffer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AcceptOffer" name="Accept offer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DenyOffer" name="Deny offer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" name="Invalidate all other offers"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteApplicantUpdates" name="Write weekly internship status updates (at least 3)"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_InternshipFinished" name="Internship finished"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTweets" name="Send a separate recommendation tweet to each friend">
      <bpmn:ioSpecification>
        <bpmn:dataInput id="DataInput_Friends" name="List of friends"/>
        <bpmn:inputSet>
          <bpmn:dataInputRefs>DataInput_Friends</bpmn:dataInputRefs>
        </bpmn:inputSet>
        <bpmn:outputSet/>
      </bpmn:ioSpecification>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopDataInputRef>DataInput_Friends</bpmn:loopDataInputRef>
        <bpmn:inputDataItem id="DataItem_Friend" name="Friend"/>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Applicant" name="Recommendations sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Applicant" targetRef="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney" targetRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AcceptOffer" name="Accept" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_AcceptOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">offerAccepted = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DenyOffer" name="Deny" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_DenyOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Task_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" targetRef="Task_WriteApplicantUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="Task_WriteApplicantUpdates" targetRef="Event_InternshipFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="Event_InternshipFinished" targetRef="Task_SendTweets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A9" sourceRef="Task_SendTweets" targetRef="EndEvent_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A10" sourceRef="Task_DenyOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company status updates" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Company" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates" name="Write 3 status updates about the intern"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Company" name="Status updates written"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Company" targetRef="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates" targetRef="EndEvent_Company"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
